note: Fix acceleration structure barriers in Vulkan. Base RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan has no acceleration-structure barrier feature at all: p_acceleration_structure_barriers, ray_query_support, AccelerationStructureInfo, and the BARRIER_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_* static_asserts are absent (0 references in base). Depends on unported raytracing/accel-structure infrastructure. Aborted.

Adreno 660 ubershader workaround. Depends on unported infrastructure: DriverWorkarounds struct, disable_ubershaders, get_driver_workarounds() (none exist in base), plus glsl change references integrate_edge_hill() which does not exist in base area_lights_inc.glsl / lm_area_lights_inc.glsl (still inlined). Also RS:: vs RSE:: namespace divergence. Aborted.

Fix AHashMap realloc AnimationPlayer crash: replace dangling AnimationData *from pointer with is_enabled/animation_name/animation_length. Header merged cleanly. Two cpp conflicts were pure context mismatch; applied the from->animation_name change while keeping our fork context (!playback_queue.is_empty(), no stray // c.blend.clear() comment). No leftover pointer-member references.

Restrict condition parsing in shader preprocessor: new ShaderExpression subclass (shader_expression.{h,cpp}) added cleanly; expression.h private->protected + virtual _get_token merged cleanly. Only conflict was the include block; resolved to match upstream (add core/os/os.h, add shader_expression.h, drop core/math/expression.h) since OS:: is used and previously came in transitively. Verified all Expression members used by ShaderExpression are in the protected region.

Fix/cleanup clearcoat reflection probe process. Base has zero occurrences of cc_reflection_accum, cc_specular_light, or light_process_area; base reflection_process() has no LIGHT_CLEARCOAT_USED parameters and no clearcoat accumulation path. The entire clearcoat-reflection-probe (and LTC area-lights) feature this PR fixes is unported. Aborted.
